name: PER_INTG_OUTBOUND_ERROR
description: This table stores a row for each unsuccessful transfer of a row to the partner.

columns.name: OUTBOUND_DATA_ERROR_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifer to identify the row.

columns.name: OUTBOUND_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Data object that wasn transferred and resulted in error in Partner system

columns.name: OUTBOUND_OBJECT_KEY
columns.description: Primay Key of the object. For example , postion identifier for postions

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: ESS job request Id that user submitted

columns.name: ERROR_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the error recieved from Partner

columns.name: ERROR_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Eror Description that partner sends back to Fusion

columns.name: PARTNER_RESPONSE_DOCUMENT
columns.description: this is the output document sent by partner

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: enterprise identifier for the mulit tenant purpose

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
